attributes.name: Girtablilu
attributes.powers:
When you examine this card, succeed at a Stealth 7 check or encounter it; the difficulty to defeat is increased by 3.

Before you act, if you have any cards that have the Attack trait in your hand, you are dealt 1d4 Poison damage.

If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from.
